style: Dutch-influenced, technically tidy Caribbean side under Dick Advocaat drawing heavily on Netherlands-developed diaspora. Organised and compact, looking to play out and counter through creative wide players.
recent_form: Completed a historic first-ever World Cup qualification, climbing the FIFA ranking from 91st in 2024 to 82nd. Drawn in a tough Group E with Germany, Ecuador and Ivory Coast.

key_players.name: Leandro Bacuna
key_players.note: 34-year-old midfielder and captain with Premier League experience at Aston Villa and Cardiff City; the team's leader.

key_players.name: Juninho Bacuna
key_players.note: Leandro's younger brother and one of the squad's most creative players; Premier League time with Huddersfield.

key_players.name: Tahith Chong
key_players.note: Ex-Manchester United winger who debuted for the Blue Wave in September 2025 and quickly showed game-changing quality.

key_players.name: Rangelo Janga
key_players.note: FC Eindhoven striker and Curacao's record scorer (21 goals in 43 caps).

key_players.name: Gervane Kastaneer
key_players.note: Combined with Kenji Gorre for eight goals in qualifying; key attacking outlet.

historical_news: Became the smallest nation by population ever to qualify for a FIFA World Cup (around 150,000 people).
First-ever World Cup appearance, having risen from 91st to 82nd in the FIFA ranking since 2024.
Veteran coach Dick Advocaat leads a Netherlands-rooted diaspora squad into Group E with Germany, Ecuador and Ivory Coast.

media_sentiment.label: positive
media_sentiment.summary: Largely celebratory coverage of a record-breaking smallest-ever qualifier, with realistic acknowledgement of a daunting group draw.
